fiduciaries.agent.primary.full_name.description: Primary agent under durable power of attorney.

outright_will.residuary.alternate.full_n.description: Alternate residuary beneficiary when the standalone outright will disposition is named.

testamentary_trust.trustee_structure.description: Testamentary trustee nomination structure: single, spouse_first, co_trustees, or unset.
